name: Pennsylvania
source: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue flat personal income tax rate of 3.07 percent; retirement distributions from age 59.5 are not taxed; both confirmed primary in validation run 2 (2026-10-22) on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/resources/tax-types-and-information/personal-income-tax and https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/forms-and-publications/pa-personal-income-tax-guide/gross-compensation, with no standard deduction (https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/forms-and-publications/pa-personal-income-tax-guide/deductions-and-credits)

state_base.note: Pennsylvania taxes employee 401(k) deferrals as compensation, so they are added back to the income the state taxes; HSA deposits stay deductible (confirmed primary: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/forms-and-publications/pa-personal-income-tax-guide/gross-compensation, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

estate_inheritance.note: Pennsylvania has no estate tax; its inheritance tax is 0% to a surviving spouse (and to a parent from a child 21 or younger), 4.5% to lineal heirs (children, grandchildren, parents), 12% to siblings and 15% to other heirs, from the first dollar (no exemption). Rates read in search extracts of the Department of Revenue inheritance tax page on 2026-10-22. Not modelled: the 5% discount for paying within three months, the family exemption, and the exemptions for some retirement accounts and jointly held property; the tax is charged on each heir's share of the estate after estate taxes. Confirmed primary on the same page (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

social_security.note: Pennsylvania does not tax Social Security benefits; it is not among the states that tax them in Kiplinger 2026 (https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/states-that-tax-social-security-benefits) and AARP, as listed in .claude/state/research/state-costs.md. Confirmed primary on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/forms-and-publications/pa-personal-income-tax-guide/gross-compensation (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: PA Department of Community and Economic Development municipal statistics (Earned Income Tax rates)
local_income_tax.note: Local earned income tax of about 1% in most municipalities (Philadelphia 3.74% for residents, Pittsburgh 3%); it taxes wages and self-employment income only, not retirement income or Social Security (state-costs.csv local_income_tax, from memory). Triage 2026-10-23 (category A): PA local EIT taxes earned income only (Act 32).

sales_tax.check_at: Pennsylvania revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: assumed equal to the combined rate. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food exempt (state and Philadelphia/Allegheny local). clothing_taxable is false (research: no; General clothing exempt; accessories fur formalwear sports taxable). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.source: PennDOT Bureau of Motor Vehicles Schedule of Fees MV-70S (4-26): passenger registration 48.00 one year, 96.00 two years (raised from 45 under Act 89, 2025; search extract, 2026-10-23)
car_taxes.note: Floor: the flat passenger registration fee; Pennsylvania has no vehicle property tax. The 5 a year fee for local use of some counties is not included. Set by hand (s328, 2026-10-23, owner decision C4: no 0 that only means unknown); a move changes the entered car tax by the dollar difference of the two states' figures, and the importer keeps a non-zero figure.

fuel.source: Excise: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/revenue/resources/tax-rates/motor-fuel-tax-rates (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.587 (0.576 tax for 2026 plus a 0.011 underground storage tank fee); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Pennsylvania insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
